sections.description:
Short title and commencement

ORDINANCE XLV OF 2002
NORTH.-WEST
FRONTIER PROVINCE REMOVAL FROM SERVICE (SPECIAL POWERS) (THIRD AMENDMENT)
ORDINANCE, 2002
ORDINANCE XLV OF 2002
An Ordinance
further to amend the North-West Frontier Province Removal from Service (Special
Powers) Ordinance, 2000
[Gazette of N.-W.
F. P., Extraordinary, 25th October, 2002]
No. LEGIS:(4)/2000/7643, dated
25-10-2002. The following Ordinance by the Governor of the North-West
Frontier Province is hereby published for general information:
1. Short title and
commencement.--(1) This Ordinance may be called the North-West Frontier
Province Removal from Service (Special Powers) (Third Amendment) Ordinance,
2002.
(2) It shall come into force at
once.

ORDINANCE XLV OF 2002

ORDINANCE, 2002
ORDINANCE XLV OF 2002
An Ordinance
further to amend the North-West Frontier Province Removal from Service (Special
Powers) Ordinance, 2000
[Gazette of N.-W.
F. P., Extraordinary, 25th October, 2002]
No. LEGIS:(4)/2000/7643, dated
25-10-2002. The following Ordinance by the Governor of the North-West
Frontier Province is hereby published for general information:
2. Amendment of section 9 of
N.-W.F.P. Ordinance No. V of 2000.--In the North-West Frontier Province
Removal from Service (Special Powers) Ordinance, 2000 (N.-W.F.P. Ordinance No.
V of 2000), hereinafter referred to as the said Ordinance, for section 9, the
following shall be substituted, namely:
"9. Representation.-(1)
A person on whom a penalty is imposed under section 3, may, within fifteen days
from the date of communication of the order, prefer a representation to the
Governor of the North-West Frontier Province or such officer or authority as
the Governor may designate:
Provided that where the order has
been made by the Governor, such person may, within the aforesaid period, submit
a presentation to the Governor.
(2) The Governor or an officer or
authority, as may be designated for the purpose by the Governor, may, on
consideration of the representation or, as the case may be, presentation, and
any other relevant material, confirm, set aside, vary or modify the order in
respect of which such representation or presentation is made. "
